summary:
Implementation Plan for NexusMC Minecraft Network Website:
- All custom ranks, crate keys, boosters, staff roster, and blog posts are 100% locally saved in the user's browser using resilient LocalStorage persistence.
- Zero dependency on backend responses to save, edit, or delete items. Your custom ranks will never be erased on refresh, tab closure, or server reboot.
- SHA-256 encrypted authentication in client code without exposing the plaintext password or requiring a database.
- Live Minecraft ping scanner continuously active for nexusmc.ultramc.co with Custom Dungeons & Survival SMP highlights.
